title: Delphi Authorization Store
description: `$DELPHI_HOME/operator/authorizations.json` (spec 092 TA-1): the operator's test authorizations. Written only by `delphi test authorize` and `delphi test revoke` (owner-only, 0600), under the operator scope's advisory lock; its blake3 hash is pinned in `operator/ratified.lock` under the key `authorizations.json#store` (a `#` key, which the file-by-file checks skip and no ratified path can equal). A file whose hash does not match its pin, or that has no pin, is ignored and logged, whatever it says. In slice S1 no run reads a record: nothing here is consumed or approves anything.

audit_head.description: The last event of the operator's audit log (operator/audit) as of the last change to this store. The store is pinned, so a deleted, cut or rewritten audit log no longer reaches it and is refused.

path.description: An absolute canonical path, or `@snapshot/<rel>` (token scheme 1): one tracked regular file of a run's snapshot, whose path does not exist when the record is made.

argv.description: The canonical argument vector, matched exactly: no globs, shell strings, wrappers, chaining or substitution. Under token scheme 1 it is SYMBOLIC: an element may be a whole token (`@snapshot`, `@snapshot/<rel>`, `@scratch`, `@canary`, `@operator_home`), never part of other text and never argv[0]; the card must equal this text, and only then does the daemon put in the paths it minted for the run.

binary.description: Absolute canonical path of argv[0] and a hash of it, taken when the operator authorized.

files.description: Every script or file the command reads and executes, each hashed at authorization time.

env.description: The fixed, scrubbed environment: no PATH search, no LD_PRELOAD, no DYLD_*.

purpose.description: The operator's words, shown at every use.

home.description: The Delphi home this record is bound to.

machine.description: The machine this record is bound to.

run.description: Required: the run id the operator chose; a launch must pass the same id.

expires.description: At most 24 hours after creation; the first-slice default is 2 hours.

uses.description: The counter a later slice decrements against; slice S1 never changes it.

request_id.description: The staged request this record was made from, or null for one the operator wrote at the console.

revoked.description: When it was revoked. Irreversible: a revoked record is only ever replaced by a new one.

token_scheme.description: 0: a record from before S2d2a, no tokens. 1: symbolic path tokens; the manifest hash covers the scheme number with the entries.

tree_blake3.description: The hash of the snapshot tree the operator saw; a run whose snapshot differs is refused. Null only when the operator passed --no-pin-tree.

snapshot.description: What the snapshot of a granted run must be (spec 092 S2d2a).
